source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-24

procedures.title: V8 engine mechanical: scope
steps: Use this section for removing and installing the engine and for replacing or adjusting the sub-assemblies listed in its index.
For full overhaul of components after removal, go to Section 6 of the Chassis Overhaul Manual.
notes: Covers the 302, 307, 327, 350, 396 and 427 cu. in. V8s in every passenger car line (see figure 1V in the manual).
